newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Buenaventura to reduce costs on silver drop.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Buenaventura to reduce costs on silver drop.

text.p: Peru's second largest silver producer, Buenaventura said Wednesday it aims to raise efficiency and reduce costs, rather than lower production, in response to falling silver prices.
"We have to go on competing in the market, therefore we are concentrating now on ... more efficiency and reduction of costs," said Carlos Galvez, finance executive for Buenaventura.
"In that way we protect ourselves from the fluctuations in the metal prices, like silver, which we consider circumstantial and which could be reversed in the medium-term."

As part of that drive for greater efficiency, Buenaventura will operate from Thursday a new energy transmitter line connecting its Uchucchacua mine to the national network, and therefore reducing energy costs, he added.
That mine is also undergoing an explansion program aimed at boosting its daily production capacity from 1,200 tonnes of mineral to 2,000 tonnes, he added.
Buenaventura produced 128.7 tonnes of silver between January and May, up 4.35 percent on the same period last year.
